issue_title: [Security] load() 未验证 JSON 文件权限，攻击者可能通过修改文件权限泄露敏感信息
summary: Added file permission validation to load() method that warns when JSON file has group or other permissions set (mode & 0o077 != 0). Uses warn-only approach for backward compatibility.

triage_summary.title: load() does not validate JSON file permissions
triage_summary.root_cause: load() in storage.py:74 reads files without checking permissions, while save() enforces 0o600
risk_points: Attacker with filesystem access could chmod file to world-readable
Sensitive todo data could be exposed to other users
triage_summary.proposed_fix: Add permission check in load() with warnings.warn() for backward compatibility
verification_targets: Test load() warns on world-readable file (0o644)
Test load() warns on group-readable file
Test load() does not warn on secure file (0o600)

files_changed.description: Added import of warnings module and permission check in load() method
New regression test file for issue #5514 with 4 test cases

test_cases.name: test_load_warns_on_world_readable_file
test_cases.description: Verifies warning when file has 0o644 (world-readable) permissions

test_cases.name: test_load_warns_on_group_readable_file
test_cases.description: Verifies warning when file has 0o640 (group-readable) permissions

test_cases.name: test_load_accepts_secure_permissions
test_cases.description: Verifies no warning when file has 0o600 (owner-only) permissions

test_cases.name: test_load_warns_on_world_writable_file
test_cases.description: Verifies warning when file has 0o606 (world-writable) permissions

risks.description: Existing tests may show warnings for files with default permissions
risks.mitigation: Warnings are expected and indicate the security check is working

risks.description: Users may see unexpected warnings if they manually created files with non-600 permissions
risks.mitigation: Warning message explains how to fix (set 0o600 permissions)

backward_compatibility: Fully compatible - warns but does not reject loading
